title: Texts in Time · Islamic Intellectual Atlas
mobile_interface_note: Chart-first Explore sheet for philosophy/kalām/logic, fiqh/uṣūl, hadith, tafsīr, taṣawwuf, grammar and balāgha; linked 30-version OpenITI source library with 5 local byte-matched texts and 25 pinned on-demand versions.
whole_range_note: Drag the six-dot grip from Whole atlas to restore a movable focus window, or tap another time on the overview to seek.
date_marker_note: Marker is a dated event, bound, uncertainty window or distinct editing stage; label width is non-temporal.
textual_family_note: 21 distinct source-verified named textual families with shared canonical work IDs. The SVG Text Network shows only existing sourced work-level relations; new fiqh, hadith, tafsir and Arabic language corpora are navigation scaffolds, not imported graph records.
pdf_note: The live web atlas includes the November 2026 Explore and 30-version source-library integration. The revision 8 offline ZIP and earlier PDFs predate these updates and contain no new corpus source reader. The 30 digital versions are not claimed as independently collated critical editions.
reader_return_links: Preserve safe debate views, passage context, filters and comparison selection.
